infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Attendance check-in only works when you are at the shop, so the app needs your location at that moment.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: A quick photo at check-in confirms you are at the shop when the location check is unclear, the counter uses the camera to photograph bills and payment receipts, and staff scan the barcode on a product to log what they have sold.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pick a payment screenshot from your photos as proof that a customer has paid.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Attendance check-in only works when you are at the shop, so the app needs your location.

plugins.cameraPermission: A quick photo at check-in confirms you are at the shop when the location check is unclear. It is deleted after 2 days.

plugins.photosPermission: Pick a payment screenshot from your photos as proof that a customer has paid.
